dek: The Transport Department (TD) today (August 28) announced that the 58th Personalised Vehicle Registration Marks (PVRMs) Scheme will be open for applications from September 1 to 30, 2026. Starting from September 1, 2026, applications will be invited for the allocation of PVRMs upon sale by auction. Completed application
